newsitem.title: ITALY: Plane breaks up in Italy after overshooting runway.
newsitem.headline: Plane breaks up in Italy after overshooting runway.

text.p: An ATR-42 turbo prop plane attempting to land at Florence airport overshot the runway and broke up near a highway on Tuesday, Italian police and airlines officials said.
The Air Littoral plane was an a flight from Nice in southern France. Ambulances and fire brigades rushed to the scene and a number of people were feared injured, they said.
First reports on Italian television said 14 passengers and an unspecified number of crew were on board.
A Red Cross spokesman said that a number of people were injured and part of the aircraft had broken off.
Fire brigades said there was a danger of an explosion and the highway linking Florence to the Mediterranean was closed.
